text: Kukatpally lo flood water ekkuva undi, 20 people trapped rooftop vundaru, medical help urgently required. Please send uddhaaram team immediately.
LB Nagar main road buried in water, vehicles moving like boats. 10 families need food and drinking water, children and elders thokaru safe avvalledu.
Old building near Secunderabad station partially collapsed after the rains. 3 people injured, ambulance and medical team needed quickly. #Hyderabad
Prakasam Barrage area flooded, Krishna river water danger level ki reach ayyindi. 34 people oka island me trapped avvu, boats needed urgently for rescue.
Cyclone warning for Vizag coast. Coconut trees down on the beach road, power lines snapped near Rameswaram. Please arrange evacuation for fishing families. 28 families waiting.
Earthquake tremor felt across Anantapur district, house walls peeling and damage. Old lady with BP problem needs doctor immediately, no hospital bed available nearby.
Velachery ellaa naalu flood la irukku. 58 people ellaram rooftop la, podsichu irukkom. Boat dhaan tharen, soodhaikkaima urgent ah! Medical help panicku.
CINL lake overflowing into neighbourhood roads, water entered ground-floor homes. Elderly residents need evacuation support, wheelchairs stuck in 2nd floor rooms.
Half-collapsed school building at Gandhipuram after the tremor yesterday. 9 children injured during lunch break, hospital bed ki urgent requirement.
Forest fire spreading fast near Sirumalai hills, smoke covering the village. 14 people trapped inside the plantation, rescue team and fire tenders needed immediately.
Whitefield ITPL corridor under 4 feet water, vehicles stranded on service road. Please send rescue teams immediately, 11 people stuck inside metro pillar area.
Landslide blocked the Bhatkal road, hill mud neda pole. 17 people missing from the downhill colony, NDRF help urgent ah eellikodalli.
Cauvery water level rising in Hassan taluk, river bank cracks forming. 22 farmers shifting to school grounds, food and clean water ki madagaali chudu.
Kuttanad area eenthi chadda, full flood conditions. 39 persons safe zone kette oru, boat pramuka, food rations illam ente. Power outage full day.
Meppadi landslide blocked the only highway, mud slides peeling every 10 minutes. 64 people stuck inside the valley with no mobile signal, SOS please! Trapped since 6 AM.
